text: The Lord keeps a record of those who take revenge and he will punish them for their sins.
So forgive those who harm you, and when you pray, God will forgive you.
But don't expect the Lord to forgive you if you hold a grudge
or refuse to show mercy.
God won't accept sacrifices for your sins if you stay angry with others.
Life is too short to waste it by being angry, so obey God and forgive your enemies.
Remember his commands and his agreement with us. Don't let the faults of others make you angry with them.
If you control your temper, you won't start arguments or sin as much.
And remember, it is sinful to start an argument that destroys a friendship.
Stubbornness heats up an argument, just as adding wood heats up a fire. If you are rich and powerful, you can afford to lose your temper.
A quick temper can blaze up and lead to murder.
Blow on a spark and it bursts into flames; spit on a spark and it dies out. In the same way, your words can either heat up an argument or make it cool down.
Those who gossip and tell lies are under God's curse, because they have brought ruin to innocent people
and forced many others to leave home and country. Such talk has been the downfall of strong cities and powerful leaders.
Because of lies others told, faithful, hard-working wives have been divorced and have lost everything[60]
So if you want peace of mind, don't listen to gossip!
Whips leave painful stripes on the skin, but cruel words break bones deep down inside
and can be more deadly than a sword. *
You should be happy if you have never been attacked with lies and gossip, or felt them wrap around you
like heavy bronze chains or a collar[61] made of iron.
Cruel words cause suffering[62] worse than death itself.
Although they are fiery flames, they cannot harm God's faithful people,
but those who reject him will be burned to ashes. And these cruel words are like lions and leopards, hunting down their victims and tearing them apart.
You protect your land with a hedge of thornbushes and you keep your money locked away safely.
Be just as careful to guard what you say. Always think before you speak, and know when to be silent,
so that others cannot attack you for what you have said.
